La razón entre observados y esperados es 5,4, con un intervalo de confianza del 95 % de 3,0 a 9,8. En diciembre se adjudicó el 0 % de los contratos junto al límite, mientras que diciembre supone el 0 % de todos sus contratos de obras. Los contratos junto al límite se reparten entre 12 adjudicatarios distintos. El contrato [1], de 38.320,25 euros, se adjudicó en septiembre de 2024.
Qué no pueden demostrar: El hecho de que se adjudiquen contratos al límite no implica que haya sido un error. Puede deberse a razones legales o a necesidades específicas.

What the data shows: Between 2023 and 2025, this body awarded 26 minor contracts for works above 37,500 and up to 40,000 euros, just under the legal limit. If those amounts were spread as in the band immediately below, 4.8 contracts would be expected. The observed-to-expected ratio is 5.4, with a 95% confidence interval of 3.0 to 9.8. December accounts for 0% of the contracts just under the limit, compared with 0% of all its works contracts. The contracts just under the limit are spread across 12 different awardees. Contract [1], for 38,320.25 euros, was awarded in September 2024.
What it cannot show: The fact that some contracts are just under the limit does not prove any wrongdoing. It could be due to market prices or budget constraints. Statistical indicators like this do not indicate improper actions by individuals or organizations.
What can be checked: Check the details of contract [1] to see what was purchased and the dates. Look at the distribution of contracts across awardees to identify any patterns. Review the contracts to see if multiple contracts cover the same need or if there are repeated orders from the same awardee.
